headlines.title: 하루 500만배럴 또 묶였다…사우디 송유관 피격 "잠정 운영 중단"
headlines.summary: 사우디아라비아 히자즈주 메디나 지역의 동서 파이프라인에서 검은 연기가 피어오르는 모습이 위성 사진에 포착됐다. /로이터=뉴스1 사우디아라비아가 이란의 호르무즈 해협 봉쇄에 대응해 원유 우회 수송의 핵심 축으로 활용해 온 '동서 파이프라인'이 드론 공격을 받아 전면 운영 중단됐다고 로이터 통신이 11일(현지시간) 사우디 국영매체를 인용해 보도했다.

headlines.title: 美 국채금리 ‘마의 5%’ 돌파… 韓 이자급증·투자감소 ‘연쇄 파장’
headlines.summary: ■ 글로벌 채권시장 긴장 고조 고유가·인플레·재정악화 영향 ‘경제 체온계’ 10년물 채권 발작 AI기업들 인프라 투자 빨라져 ‘5% 금리’ 뉴노멀 굳어질 수도 14일 미국 뉴욕증권거래소(NYSE)에서 한 트레이더가 모니터를 통해 각종 지표를 확인하고 있다. 이날 미국 10년 만기 국채 금리가 장중 5%를 넘어 2023년 10월 이후 최고치를 기록했다.

headlines.title: 유가 급등에 美 10년물 5% 돌파…AI 관련주 '휘청'(종합)
headlines.summary: 국제유가 급등이 직접 원인 재정적자·AI 투자용 회사채 발행까지 겹쳐 AI 관련주 급락…증시 고평가 부담도 확대 베선트 장기채 바이백에도 금리 상승 글로벌 장기금리의 벤치마크 역할을 하는 미국 10년 만기 국채 금리가 결국 5%를 돌파했다.

headlines.title: 회사채 만기 돌아오는데 … 국내기업 자금조달 ‘ 경고등 ’
headlines.summary: 고금리에 R&D 등 지연 예상 당국은 ‘긴급 바이백’ 검토 미국 국채 10년물 금리가 5%를 돌파하면서 국내 기업들의 조달비용 부담에도 경고등이 켜졌다. 글로벌 채권금리 상승세가 국내 시장금리를 끌어올리면서 기업들이 회사채를 새로 발행하거나 만기 도래 물량을 차환할 때 부담해야 할 이자 비용이 커질 수 있다.

headlines.title: 국세청, ‘ 물가불안 조장 ’ 탈세 혐의 41곳 세무조사
headlines.summary: 배민, 1조대 국내 이익 獨 모회사 이전 ‘금란’ 양계장·무신사 패션플랫폼 조사 국세청이 추석을 앞두고 먹거리와 배달·패션 플랫폼 등 생활물가 밀접 업종의 탈루 혐의 업체 41곳에 대해 세무조사에 착수했다. 국세청은 농축산물·가공식품·외식 프랜차이즈 등 먹거리 관련 업체와 소비재 플랫폼 업체에서 탈루 혐의를 포착했다고 15일 밝혔다.

headlines.title: 8월 수출 983억달러 '역대 최대' … 반도체가 또 견인
headlines.summary: 핵심요약 관세청, '2026년 8월 월간 수출입 현황(확정치)' 발표 반도체 수출 468억달러, 전년比 206.1% 급증…18개월 연속 증가 대중 수출 119.4%·대미 수출 89.2%↑…수출 중량은 5개월째 감소 2026년 8월 월간 수출입 현황. 관세청 제공 올해 8월 우리나라 수출이 반도체 수출 호조에 힘입어 역대 8월 중 최대치를 기록했다.

headlines.title: 세계 반도체 2분기 매출 사상최대 …‘ 메모리 비중 ’ 50% 첫 돌파

headlines.summary: 9월 6일 서울 중구 명동의 한 환전소에 환율이 표시돼있다. [사진=연합뉴스] [디지털데일리 이호연기자] 1560원까지 치솟았던 환율이 두 달여 만에 200원 넘게 떨어졌다. 반도체 수출 호조와 기업 달러 매도 등에 힘입은 결과다. 환율 급락에 기업과 개인의 달러 매수도 늘면서 5대 은행 달러예금은 역대 최대 수준까지 불어났다.

key_headlines.summary: August exports reached an all-time high of 98.3 billion dollars, with semiconductor exports surging 206.1% year-over-year to 46.8 billion dollars, marking 18 consecutive months of growth.

key_headlines.title: US 10-Year Treasury Yield Breaks 5% Threshold, Creating Global Market Tensions
key_headlines.summary: The US 10-year Treasury yield surpassed 5% for the first time since October 2023, signaling tightening global financial conditions and potential headwinds for Korean interest rates and investments.

key_headlines.title: Global Semiconductor Market Reaches Record High with Memory Chips Surpassing 50% Share
key_headlines.summary: Global semiconductor sales reached an all-time high in Q2 2026, with memory chips accounting for 54% of the market, demonstrating continued strong demand despite AI speed-control discussions.

key_headlines.title: Korean Ramen Exports Surge 21% to Break 1.5 Billion Dollars Annually via FTA Benefits
key_headlines.summary: Korean instant noodles exports reached 1.5 billion dollars annually with 21% year-over-year growth, bolstered by tariff-free benefits from free trade agreements with the US, China, and ASEAN.

key_headlines.title: Bank of Japan Raises Interest Rates to 1.25%, Highest Level in 31 Years
key_headlines.summary: The Bank of Japan raised its benchmark rate by 25 basis points to 1.25%, the highest in 31 years, as inflation pressures broaden and medium-term inflation expectations rise.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's exports are poised to reach the historic 1 trillion dollar milestone for the first time annually, with semiconductors driving exceptional growth. However, economic experts warn of over-reliance on semiconductors and advocate for simultaneous policy development in defense and nuclear industries. The semiconductor boom provides a critical window to restructure traditional industries like automobiles, steel, and petrochemicals toward higher value-added products while nurturing next-generation sectors such as biotech and healthcare. As Korea's export structure becomes increasingly concentrated in semiconductors, policymakers must prepare contingency plans for when the semiconductor supercycle eventually ends.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The US Federal Reserve raised its benchmark rate to 4.0%, with the Fed's dot plot suggesting additional rate increases later this year and into 2027, putting pressure on Korean monetary policy. Taiwan's central bank held rates steady at 2% for the 10th consecutive time while revising up 2026 GDP growth expectations to 11.48% from 9.45%. Japan's Bank of Japan increased rates to 1.25%, the highest level in 31 years, as inflation pressures broaden across the region. August producer prices in Korea rose 0.2% month-over-month, driven by soaring temperatures and rising oil prices, with agricultural products and utilities experiencing notable increases. Global central banks face the challenge of balancing continued inflationary pressures with economic growth concerns.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI index rebounded strongly by 2.66% despite initial shock from the Fed's rate hike, recovering above the 6,800 level as foreign and institutional investors resumed buying. Foreign investors returned to net buying of Korean stocks in August for the first time this year, purchasing 1.9 trillion won on the KOSPI while selling 1.5 trillion won on the KOSDAQ. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix surged 3-6% on improved sentiment, driven by declining oil prices and US Treasury yields, plus strong performance from US semiconductor stocks. However, foreign investors liquidated over 12 trillion won in Samsung and SK Hynix shares during a recent one-week period due to concerns about AI investment slowdown and potential memory chip peak-out.
sections.Industry & Technology: Saudi Arabia's business delegation of approximately 50 executives is scheduled to visit Seoul next month to discuss investment opportunities in AI, electric vehicles, digital infrastructure, and other emerging industries. The Doosan Group is expanding its semiconductor value chain from copper-clad laminate (CCL) to wafers and system semiconductor testing, committing approximately 1 trillion won for additional AI data center CCL capacity. Volvo has launched its premium electric vehicle flagship model ES90, combining SUV spaciousness with sedan driving dynamics to appeal to diverse consumer preferences. Foreign investors show caution toward semiconductors amid AI speed-control debates, with major brokerages divided on sector outlook.
sections.Real Estate: Autumn apartment sales market is showing signs of warming as real estate demand concentrates on prime redevelopment locations in core downtown areas. However, lending restrictions combined with rising interest rates have increased the financial burden on homebuyers, while uncertainty surrounding real estate tax reforms continues to dampen market sentiment. Financial regulators have decided to increase risk weights for high-value mortgages exceeding 2.5 billion won with LTV ratios surpassing 40%, strengthening banking sector soundness in preparation for real estate downturns. Authorities have cracked down on over 10,000 fraudulent real estate advertisements, with 55.4% involving false claims, including cases where hostels were misrepresented as residential units and mortgages of over 1.2 billion won were concealed.
sections.International Economy: Hyundai Motor CEO warned that without protective barriers like tariffs and market entry regulations, the US could experience Chinese vehicle market penetration similar to Europe's situation. The US currently imposes approximately 100% tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles, though President Trump recently indicated openness to Chinese automakers establishing local production facilities. The Fed's latest rate increase and subsequent dot plot projections suggest continued monetary tightening despite moderating inflation, influencing global capital flows and currency markets. Japan's faster monetary tightening timeline creates uncertainty regarding yen appreciation, as the yen's currency movements remain unclear amid shifting global rate differentials.
sections.AI & Economy: Geoffrey Hinton, known as the 'godfather of AI,' warned the US Congress that policymakers have only about one year remaining to establish meaningful AI regulations as systems increasingly design improved versions of themselves. Hinton emphasized the need to slow development pace and expedite safety measures as AI enters more autonomous stages of advancement. A company called Sangsan Woori reported creating 500 jobs through senior-focused AI and digital business initiatives, implementing the government's 'Mid-Career Second Leap Rights' policy announced in July. The integration of human-AI collaboration in job creation represents a strategic approach to workforce development during the industrial transition period.
sections.Others: Macquarie Asset Management's takeover bid for Korean cloud and IT company Gabia has failed due to insufficient shareholder participation, with stock purchase agreements now at risk of termination. Apple's iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max officially launched in Korea on September 18, included among 65 countries in the first release wave, with prices starting at 1.99 million won and initial high demand. Billionaire donors in the US overwhelmingly favor Republican candidates, with 16 of the top 20 wealthy donors leaning toward the party, primarily due to interests in AI regulation and pro-business policies. Samsung SDS and NHN shares surged 38%, while Naver lagged, as AI data center operators face challenges in securing long-term customers to cover high interest expenses during the capital investment phase.
